title.en: Planning and influence are not a single act
title.zh: 计划与影响并不是同一行动

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的宁七题依次选1、2、3、4、5、3、3，乔选5、4、3、2、1、3、3，两项原始和均21、均值3.00，保密、低调、计划等陈述上的认同却不同。宁为普通活动列计划，也不证明其实施过操纵。网页只归纳本人选择，没核实动机、其他人的意图或某件事的责任；同一均值不是同一行为档案。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Ning selects 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 3, 3; Jo selects 5, 4, 3, 2, 1, 3, 3. Both sums are 21 and means 3.00, with different agreement about secrecy, discretion and planning. Planning an ordinary activity proves no manipulation. The page summarises self-reports without verifying motives, others’ intentions or responsibility for an event; equal means are no identical behavioral record.

title.en: An optional question about one belief
title.zh: 可选地看一条具体看法

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样区分一条信念、一个可观察行动与未核实的意图？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，说明已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、拒绝回答或停止。无需交换本人分数、法律或暴力经历、他人身份，不邀请任何人验证谁更“黑暗”，也不以拒绝讨论推断人格。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can a belief, an observable action and an unverified intention be kept separate?” Use only the fictional people and information above to separate what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, declining or stopping is allowed without scores, legal or violent experiences, or identities. No one is invited to establish who is darker, and declining implies no trait.

title.en: Seven direct ratings and an unrounded mean
title.zh: 七条同向评分与原始均值

paragraphs.zh: 本页为发表版SD4的28条英文自报陈述，四组固定各七条，同向计分、零反向。中文为本站工作译文，未独立验证或建立语言等值。原选项为1非常不同意、2不同意、3中立、4同意、5非常同意；3不是缺答。未评分为网站另加选项，可表示不愿回答、不确定或题意不适用，网页不区分其具体原因。28题各选给定项即可完成；某组七条全为数值时，用原始和7至35除以7得均值1至5，再显示两位小数，不先舍入中间均值。任一未评分则仅该组不显示均值或部分原始和，不补0、不填3、不按剩余题折算；有效数与未评分数仍可见，其他完整组独立保留。全未评分也可完成，四篇八节全文始终开放，不需补答、注册或支付。没有统一回忆时段，不另加过去一月、一年或频率解释。四项不相加、不排名、不选最高类型、不生成黑暗百分比、人口百分位、临床或危险性界线；与Mini 18题、SD3、Dirty Dozen及其他问卷不互换。发表研究、作者工具与公有领域许可不验证此网页、工作中译或本站用户常模，也不为编辑新增例子背书。研究名称不证明道德、疾病、犯罪、意图、收入、性兴趣、他人感受或关系安全；低值也不是无害证明。数字完整不等于独立核实了自报，重测差异不能确定真实改变、原因或达到可靠变化阈值。新增例子为虚构，讨论可以只分清题意和证据，不替别人作答、不要求确认或披露敏感经历，不建议操纵、挑衅、伤害或实际行为实验。可读完即止，不需要承担社交任务。答案仅留当前页面内存，无草稿、测试流程统计、个人结果URL或个人结果分享按钮；刷新、换语言或离开后不提供恢复，退出清空，重测从空白开始。公开四份指南内容对人人相同，不带个人均值或答案；截屏、浏览器记录和旁人看屏不因清空而被抹除。
paragraphs.en: This page uses the published SD4’s 28 English self-report statements in four fixed seven-item groups, all direct with zero reversals. Chinese is an independent working translation without validation or established language equivalence. Source anchors are one Strongly Disagree, two Disagree, three Neutral, four Agree and five Strongly Agree; three is not missing. Unscored is a website addition covering refusal, uncertainty or unsuitable wording without distinguishing the reason. Every item needs an offered response to finish. Seven numeric ratings in a group give a raw sum from seven to 35, divided by seven for a mean from one to five and then displayed to two decimals without rounding an intermediate mean. Any unscored response withholds only that group’s mean and partial sum, without zero, midpoint or remaining-item imputation. Numeric and unscored counts stay visible and other complete groups remain independent. An all-unscored attempt can finish, with all four eight-section guides open without further answers, signup or payment. There is no common recall window and no added past-month, past-year or frequency interpretation. Subscales are not combined, ranked, assigned a highest type or converted to a darkness percentage, population percentile, clinical or dangerousness cutoff. They do not interchange with Mini 18, SD3, Dirty Dozen or other instruments. Publication, author materials and public-domain permission validate neither this website, working Chinese nor norms for its users, and endorse no added examples. Research names establish no morality, disorder, crime, intention, income, sexual interest, others’ feelings or relationship safety; low values certify no harmlessness. Complete arithmetic independently verifies no self-report. Repeat differences establish no genuine change, cause or reliable-change threshold. New examples are fictional. Discussions can clarify wording and evidence without rating someone else, seeking reassurance, disclosing sensitive events or trying manipulation, provocation, harm or behavioral experiments. Reading can end the activity without social tasks. Responses stay in page memory without drafts, quiz-flow statistics, personal-result URLs or personal-result sharing buttons. Refreshing, language changes or leaving offer no restoration; exit clears, and retaking starts blank. The four public guides are identical for everyone without personal means or responses. Clearing erases no screenshots, browser records or screen observation.

title.zh: 显眼与受到称赞可以不同

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的沐对“偶尔展示”较认同，对“没我集体活动无聊”不认同；思的回答相反，七题仍可能同为21、均值3.00。两人均值都不能核实真实领导力、别人喜不喜欢或将来是否成名。若其中一题选未评分，即使另外六条很高，也不按六条生成本项均值，更不据此给人物补一个人格障碍标签。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Mu endorses occasional showing off more than the claim that group activities are dull without them; Si gives the opposite pattern. Their seven-item sums can still both be 21, averaging 3.00. Neither verifies leadership, others’ liking or future fame. An unscored item withholds this mean even if six remaining ratings are high, without filling it from six items or assigning a personality-disorder label.

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样谈具体自我看法，而不把均值当成别人评价或临床结论？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，说明已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、拒绝回答或停止。无需交换本人分数、法律或暴力经历、他人身份，不邀请任何人验证谁更“黑暗”，也不以拒绝讨论推断人格。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can a particular self-view be discussed without treating the mean as others’ evaluation or a clinical conclusion?” Use only the fictional people and information above to separate what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, declining or stopping is allowed without scores, legal or violent experiences, or identities. No one is invited to establish who is darker, and declining implies no trait.

title.en: A sensitive item can remain unscored
title.zh: 敏感题可以不作数值回答

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的羽对过去事件的一题不愿作数值回答，明确选未评分；安七题全有效，和为19，显示19÷7=2.71。网页可同时保留羽本项资料不足与安的均值，但不能推断羽隐瞒什么、安是否危险或事件如何发生。2.71来自原始和，不先把通用计分的单小数摘要当成2.7再转为2.70。其他完整维度照常独立保留。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Yu declines a numeric response about a past event and selects unscored. An supplies seven ratings summing to 19, displayed as 19 ÷ 7 = 2.71. Yu’s withheld mean and An’s number imply nothing about concealment, dangerousness or how an event unfolded. The 2.71 comes from the raw sum, not a generic one-decimal summary of 2.7 formatted as 2.70. Other complete subscales remain independent.

title.en: Keep any reflection private and specific
title.zh: 让进一步观察保持私密和具体

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样尊重未评分而不猜原因，并把原始计算与对人的推断分开？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，说明已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、拒绝回答或停止。无需交换本人分数、法律或暴力经历、他人身份，不邀请任何人验证谁更“黑暗”，也不以拒绝讨论推断人格。
paragraphs.en: An optional discussion prompt asks: “How can an unscored response be respected without guessing why, while calculation remains separate from personal inference?” Use only the fictional people and information above to separate what is known, inferred and unknown. Disagreeing, declining or stopping is allowed without scores, legal or violent experiences, or identities. No one is invited to establish who is darker, and declining implies no trait.

title.en: Fictional media does not establish real-world harm
title.zh: 虚构媒介不能证明现实伤害

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创虚构情境：虚构的悦较认同一条虚构媒介偏好，却不认同为取乐发刻薄评论；橙模式不同，也可能得到相同七题均值。这个数字不能把观看内容变成真实伤害、把知道言语能伤人变成已经伤害过谁，也不推断性兴趣或关系安全。只需谈题意怎样被理解，不重看刺激材料、不挑衅或让真人承受某种“验证”。
paragraphs.en: An additional original fictional scene: Fictional Yue endorses a fictional-media preference but not posting mean comments for fun; Cheng’s different pattern can produce the same seven-item mean. The number turns neither viewing into real harm nor awareness of hurtful words into proof of hurting someone. It establishes no sexual interest or relationship safety. Discuss wording without revisiting disturbing material, provoking anyone or subjecting a real person to a test.

title.en: Notice one interpretation without testing harm
title.zh: 留意一种理解，不用伤害作测试

paragraphs.zh: 可选讨论提示：“怎样区别媒介、信念、真实行为与后果，同时不重演任何伤害？”只使用上述虚构人物与信息，说明已知、推断与未知；可以不同意、拒绝回答或停止。无需交换本人分数、法律或暴力经历、他人身份，不邀请任何人验证谁更“黑暗”，也不以拒绝讨论推断人格。
